_note: snappyHexMesh native meshing profile. Merged only when mesher = snappy.
_merge_order: DEFAULT_CONFIG -> this profile -> case config -> case mesh_params_snappy -> case overrides
_override_how: Repeat any key in your case config (e.g. "snap": {"nSolveIter": 300}), or drop configs/meshers/snappy.json for a project-local override.

mesh_params._cell_size_mode: 'relative_levels' = snappy-native: level n means base_cell_size / 2**n, with surface_level = [body level, feature level] and edge_level for the extracted feature edges. Setting mesh_params.body_cell_size in the case config switches to an absolute intent and the levels are derived from it.
mesh_params._cell_budget: snappy caps the mesh with maxGlobalCells/maxLocalCells (ocd 3-8x the expected cell count is a sane cap; the fidelity presets already set it).

layers._first_layer_mode: 'relative' = firstLayerThickness as a fraction of the local cell size (native snappy). 'absolute' = layers.first_layer_height in metres, converted to a fraction of the body cell; snappy clamps the real stack, so treat the result as nominal.
